name: The Ships of Men
source:
You were born in a quiet seaside village with a power that belongs only to you: you're the ocean's handler. 

That is why, of course, you've been enrolled in the Temple of the Third Fate since you were very young. Now, with the Moon and Sea Dance rapidly approaching, responsibilities are heavier than ever. Sometimes, the weight of tradition is too much for a 16 year old. 

Thank goodness here is two of you! You don't know what you'd do without the person that has been by your side your whole life. 

[From [url=https://zephyrean-inquire.itch.io/the-ships-of-men]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你出生在一个安静的海边村庄，拥有只属于你的力量：你是海洋的管理者。

当然，这就是为什么你从小就被录取到第三命运神殿的原因。现在，随着月海舞的临近，责任比以往任何时候都更加沉重。有时候，传统对于一个16岁的孩子来说太沉重了。

谢天谢地，这里有你们两个！你不知道如果没有那个陪伴你一生的人你会做什么。

[来自[url=https://zephyrean-inquire.itch.io/the-ships-of-men]itch.io[/url]]
